texts.zh: 你们是瞧不起我们吗，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？！难道你们以为我们不会注意到，在同意终结[FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName]进行的不当实验后，你们自己却开始进行了同样的实验！？我们无法容忍你们这样阳奉阴违的做法。准备迎接我们的回应吧。
texts.en: Do you think us fools, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?! Do you think we would not notice that, after agreeing to end the heretical research in the [FallenEmpireTaskTarget.GetName], you yourselves would begin to pursue the very same lines of research?! We will not be mocked by worthless little savages that have barely even mastered the atom. Prepare yourselves for our response.

tooltips.zh: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName]一定会十分不满，搞不好还会教训我们一番。
tooltips.en: [FallenEmpireTaskOrigin.GetName] will be most displeased, and may decide to teach us a lesson.
